description: Starts signing in again for a connection whose sign-in stopped working (list_connections shows it with `attention`). The same connection gets new access, with its settings kept. The person signs in on the service's own page, from a CodeGene page this call opens for them or returns as a link. Owners and admins only. If your prompt or page never appears and the call times out, call it again with finish_with set to "link".

finish_with.description: Leave out. "link" returns a CodeGene page link for the person to open instead of showing a prompt or opening the page for them, for an assistant that cannot.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: reconnect_service
title: Sign in to a service again
